**Embracing a New Chapter in Solar**

I'd like to start by acknowledging the exciting transition you're embarking on from Renewable Energy into a career as a Solar Professional. This is not just a job change, but an opportunity to harness your passion for sustainability and energy efficiency to drive positive impact. As you navigate this new chapter, I'm here to support you in exploring the diverse and rapidly evolving landscape of solar jobs.

Let's dive into some of the most relevant and exciting roles that align with your skills and experience. With a background in Solar PV system design and engineering, as well as EV programme management, you'll find these opportunities particularly compelling:

### **Solar Installation Manager**

As an experienced engineer and project manager, you'll excel in this role overseeing the installation of solar panel systems for residential and commercial clients. Your expertise in designing efficient solar systems will serve as a valuable asset in ensuring smooth installations, meeting client expectations, and driving customer satisfaction. Check out some current job listings on [TotalJobs](https://www.totaljobs.com/jobs/solar-installer-jobs) or [LinkedIn](https://uk.linkedin.com/jobs/solar-installer-jobs).

### **Solar Energy Engineer**

Your engineering background will serve you well in this role, where you'll design and develop innovative solar energy solutions for various applications. Your experience with EV programme management has likely given you a deep understanding of the importance of integrating renewable energy sources into transportation systems. This role will allow you to leverage your expertise to create sustainable, efficient, and cost-effective solar energy solutions. Explore current openings on [LinkedIn](https://uk.linkedin.com/jobs/solar-energy-jobs) or [TotalJobs](https://www.totaljobs.com/jobs/solar-pv-jobs).

### **Solar Project Developer**

In this role, you'll drive the development of solar projects from concept to completion, ensuring that they meet regulatory requirements and customer expectations. Your experience in managing EV programmes has likely given you a keen eye for detail and an ability to balance technical expertise with business acumen. This role will challenge you to think creatively about how to develop and implement successful solar energy projects that drive growth and revenue. Check out current job listings on [LinkedIn](https://uk.linkedin.com/jobs/solar-jobs-london).

These roles offer a glimpse into the exciting opportunities available in the solar industry. I'm here to guide you through this transition, exploring these and other roles in more depth to find the best fit for your skills, interests, and career aspirations.
